description: Savings Dai (sDAI) is a tokenized wrapper around MakerDAO's Dai Savings Rate. Users deposit DAI, which is joined into the Vat and then into the Pot; they receive transferable ERC20 shares that represent normalized Pot balance (pie) and accrue value as the Pot's rate accumulator chi grows. It implements ERC4626 with real-time share/asset conversion and EIP-2612/ERC-1271 permit.

explicit_contracts.name: SavingsDai
explicit_contracts.description: The sDAI token and ERC4626 vault. Holds the protocol's whole Pot position (pie) in its own name and issues one share per unit of pie.

external_actors.name: Pot
external_actors.role: MakerDAO Dai Savings Rate module: tracks normalized savings balances (pie), the rate accumulator chi, last-drip time rho and the savings rate dsr.
assumptions: chi is a RAY-scaled accumulator and drip() sets chi to rpow(dsr, now - rho) * chi / RAY and rho to now
join(wad) credits pie to msg.sender only, and requires rho == now
exit(wad) debits pie of msg.sender only
Modelled by certora/harnesses/Pot.sol, a 0.8 port of dss pot.sol

external_actors.name: Vat
external_actors.role: MakerDAO CDP engine holding internal DAI balances (rad).
assumptions: move(src,dst,rad) requires src to have authorised msg.sender via hope, and is conserving

external_actors.name: DaiJoin
external_actors.role: Adapter converting ERC20 DAI to Vat DAI and back.
assumptions: join(usr,wad) burns wad DAI from msg.sender and moves wad*RAY Vat DAI to usr
exit(usr,wad) moves wad*RAY Vat DAI from msg.sender and mints wad DAI to usr

external_actors.name: Dai
external_actors.role: The DAI ERC20 token (the vault asset).
assumptions: Standard ERC20 transferFrom semantics, mint/burn by the authorised DaiJoin

external_actors.name: ERC1271 signer
external_actors.role: Smart-contract wallet that may validate permit signatures.
assumptions: Arbitrary code; only its return value matters for permit

external_actors.name: Users
external_actors.role: Token holders, spenders and depositors (EOAs or contracts).

SavingsDai.name: ERC20 token
requirements: The implementation must conserve total supply on transfers and move exactly the requested amount between the two accounts.
The implementation must reject transfers to the zero address and to the token contract itself.
The implementation must only let a spender move another account's tokens up to its allowance, and must not decrease an infinite allowance.
The implementation must only change allowances of the caller, except via transferFrom/withdraw/redeem spending and permit.

SavingsDai.name: ERC4626 vault
SavingsDai.description: Deposit/mint DAI for shares and withdraw/redeem shares for DAI, with previews and conversions at the current (possibly un-dripped) chi.
requirements: The implementation must back every outstanding share by one unit of pie held by SavingsDai in the Pot.
The implementation must charge depositors and pay withdrawers amounts consistent with chi, rounding in favour of the vault.
The implementation must make preview functions agree with the actual operation at the same chi.
The implementation must only burn an owner's shares by the owner or a sufficiently approved spender.
interactions: Pot (drip, chi, rho, dsr, join, exit)

SavingsDai.name: Permit
SavingsDai.description: EIP-2612 approvals by ECDSA signature or ERC-1271 contract signature, with per-owner nonces.
requirements: The implementation must reject expired permits and the zero owner.
The implementation must consume exactly one nonce per successful permit and only set the allowance of the signing owner.
The implementation must never decrease a nonce.
